title: Identifying and Analyzing Pitfalls in GNN Systems
problem: Graph Neural Network systems suffer from unexplored performance bottlenecks, design inefficiencies, and implementation issues that limit their practical effectiveness. Existing GNN frameworks have common pitfalls that impact scalability and correctness.
motivation: Understanding and addressing pitfalls in GNN systems is essential for building more efficient and robust neural network systems at scale.
method: The paper tests real Graph Neural Network systems to measure their performance and identify bottlenecks—the operations that consume the most time. The researchers systematically compare different GNN frameworks and analyze where computation time is spent in each. This reveals common design inefficiencies that repeatedly appear across multiple implementations.
key_novelty: This work systematically identifies and categorizes design flaws in production Graph Neural Network systems.
contributions: Comprehensive empirical study of pitfalls in GNN system implementations
Performance characterization revealing bottlenecks in GNN frameworks
Analysis of common design inefficiencies affecting GNN execution
Guidelines for improving GNN system architecture and implementation
limitations: Not discussed in available title information.
